params.name: createdAt.gt
params.description: You can use this param to provide an epoch milli value and the responses will contain invoices whose date are greater than the given invoice created date.

params.name: createdAt.eq
params.description: You can use this param to provide an epoch milli value and the responses will contain exact matches of invoices that match the given invoice created date.

params.name: createdAt.lt
params.description: You can use this param to provide an epoch milli value and the responses will contain invoices whose date are less than the given invoice created date.

params.name: createdAt.ge
params.description: You can use this param to provide an epoch milli value and the responses will contain invoices whose date are greater than or equal to the given invoice created date.

params.name: createdAt.le
params.description: You can use this param to provide an epoch milli value and the responses will contain invoices whose date are less than or equal to the given invoice created date.

params.name: companyId.eq
params.description: You can use this param to provide a customer company id and the responses will contain exact matches of invoices that match the given customer company id.

params.name: companyId.oneOf
params.description: You can use this param to provide customer company ids separated by commas and the responses will contain matches of invoices that match any of the given customer company id.

params.name: companyId.noneOf
params.description: You can use this param to provide customer company id separated by commas and the responses will not contain matches of invoices that match the given set of customer company id.

params.name: invoiceNumber.eq
params.description: Filter by invoice number (equals).

params.name: invoiceNumber.cn
params.description: You can use this param to specify some text and the responses will contain invoices that contain the given text in their invoice number

params.name: invoiceNumber.nc
params.description: You can use this param to specify some text and the responses will contain invoices that _DO NOT_ contain the given text in their invoice number

params.name: status.eq
params.description: You can use this param to provide status and the responses will contain invoices that are equal to the given status

params.name: status.oneOf
params.description: You can use this param to provide statuses and the responses will contain invoices that match one of the given statuses

params.name: status.noneOf
params.description: You can use this param to provide statuses and the responses will contain invoices that matches none of the given statuses
